summary: Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri A.S. filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026 to announce the date for its second quarter 2026 financial results. The results for the period April 1 to June 30, 2026 are scheduled for public release on August 13, 2026, after Borsa Istanbul trading hours. The filing includes a press release and contact information for investor relations. This is a routine financial results calendar announcement with no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The registrant is simply updating the market on its earnings release schedule, which is an ordinary disclosure for a foreign private issuer. No deal terms or transaction specifics are provided.
